content: Hessafe guye he kiitanchchazi Xoossa algafenne Dorsaza algaafe keziza mastoote mala xillo qizhzhi gida de7o haaththa shaafa tana bessides.

He shaafazi he katamays waanna ogeza giddo addan shaakki yeggidi aadhdhi bees; he shaafazas hadirsa baggaranne ushachcha baggara aginan aginan pacey baynda layththan tammanne nam7u agina kumeth ayfiza de7o miththi dees; he miththaa hayththay dere paththees.
Hessafe guye qanggeththi mulekka deenna; Xoossa algaynne Dorsaza algay he katamayn daana; iza oosanchchati izas goynnana.
Istti iza ayfeso beyana; iza sunththi istta liiphe bolla daana.
Hessafe guye qamay deenna; Godaa Xoossi isttas poo7iza gishshas tama poo7oy woykko arshe poo7oy isttas koshshenna; istti mernaappe mernaas kawotana.
Yesusas Nam7anththo Yuus
Hessafe guye kiitanchchazi taas, «Hayti qaalati ammanettidaytanne tumata; nabeta haasayssiza Godaa Xoossi mata wode hananayssa ba oosanchchatas qonccisanaas ba kiitanchchaza kiittides» gides.
Yesusikka, «Hekko ta eeson yaana; hayssa maxaafaza tinbite qaala naagizaadey izi anjjettidaade» gides.

Hayta ha yo7ota siyidaynne be7iday tana Yohannisa; tani hayta ha yo7ota siyida wodenne be7ida wode hayta ha yo7ota tana bessida kiitanchchaza sinththan izas goynnanaas hokkada iza toho bolla kundadis.
He kiitanchchazi qasse, «Haysso agga! Hayssaththo ooththofa! Tanikka nenara ne ishataranne nabetara qasseka hayssa maxaafaza qaala poliza asatara ooththizaade; neni Xoossas xalla goynna» gides.
Qasseka, «Wodey matida gishshas neni hayssa maxaafazan xaafettida tinbite qaalaa maatamen gordofa.
Hayssafe guye makkallizay gujji makkallo, tunaykka tuno, xilloyka xilli kaallo, geeshshayka geeyo» gides.
«Hekko! Ta eeson yaana! Issaades issaades iza ooso mala ta izas izas immana waaga tani ta kushen oykka uttadis.
Alfaynne Oomegay, Sinththinne Guyey, Koyroynne Wurseththi tana» gides.
He de7o miththa ayfe maanaassinne he katamayo izi pengera gelanaas bessizayti ba may7o meeccidayti anjjettidayta.
Kana mala coo hoththu hoththizayti, bita bitizayti, laymatizayti, shemppo wodhizayti, eeqas goynnizayti, wordo siiqizaytinne wordo ooththizayti wurikka he katamayppe karen attana.
«Tani Yesusi hayssa inttes markkattana mala ta kiitanchchaza Woosa Keeththatas yeddadis; taas yeleta zarkkeynne qommoy kase Dawitekko; tani poo7isiza wontta xoolintte.»
Xillo Ayanaynne iza mishiraya, «Haa ya!» geettes; hessa siyizaadeyka, «Ne haa ya!» go. Saamettidaadeyka haa yo; koyidaadey de7o haaththe aykko waagakka qanxxontta coo mela uyo.

Hekko tani hayssa maxaafazan xaafettida tinbite qaalaa siyizayti naagettana mala yootays. Oonikka hayssa ha qaalaa bolla aykkoka gujjiko hayssa ha maxaafazan xaafettida boshata Xoossi iza bolla gujjana.
Oonikka hayssa tinbite maxaafaan xaafettida qaalatappe issinokka pacisikko hayssa ha maxaafazan yootettida de7o miththa ayfeppenne geeshsha katamayppe Xoossi iza gishaza pacisana.
Haytantta ta markkattizayssi, «Tani addafe eeson yaana!» gees. Amiin! Godaa Yesusa haa ya.
Godaa Yesusa kiyateththi inttenara ubbatara
gido. Amiin!

footnotes.text: Ubbatara: Ubbatara gizayssa issi issi Geeshsha Maxaafati «Ubbatara» gishin harati qasse «Xoossa deretara» geettes. Qasseka «Xoossa dere ubbatara» gizaytikka deettes.
